ThreadToolCleanupStatus.description: Tool-result cleanup progress for a loaded thread's current model route.

enabled.description: Whether background tool marking runs on the current model route.

marking.description: Whether a background marking request is in flight.

pendingSavingsTokens.description: Estimated context tokens released by applying every current validated mark.

requiredSavingsTokens.description: Release required before automatic cleanup applies the marks.

releasedTokens.description: Estimated context tokens released; zero when no mark could shorten the history.
